items.title: Normalization commutes with a smooth morphism under a finiteness condition on components
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a smooth morphism whose target has finitely many irreducible components in every quasi-compact open, the lemma shows the same for the source and identifies the normalization of the source with the base change of the normalization of the target, uniquely over the source. The proof uses smoothness to control the local behaviour of components, verifies the finiteness condition passes to the source, and then compares the two normalizations through the base change. Transporting the normalization across the smooth morphism is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 5417-5436.
